observations: A dark, bulky figure sits upright at center, its mouth showing a horizontal tooth row and a red-tinged eye; yellow line-work traces the body's edges against a purple-teal torso, and a bright white oval floats above the head.
The lower half is filled with loose white and cream circular looping forms on a blue-lavender ground, suggesting foam or cloud without defining either precisely.
Upper left holds a large soft yellow disc bleeding into orange and gold; the background shifts from warm yellow-gold on the left to muted rose-brown on the right.
reading: A heavy dark figure sits amid billowing white loops, its exposed tooth row and red-tinged eye giving the face an unsettled charge. A bright white oval above the head reads as both possible light source and ironic marker—brightness pressed against something rawer below. Yellow line-work crackles across the dark mass, and the warm solar disc at upper left pulls against the cooler blue ground, keeping the mood hard to settle.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, the layered warm-cool sky and looping white cloud forms here contrast sharply with the flat teal field and spare black silhouette of title-neighbor nnxyz nnotb #64, showing the tonal range the collector values.
